review_material.assessment: The source provides a quantitative cluster for the incompressible kinetic energy E_i versus quench duration tau_Q at two temperatures (T=10^-6 and T=1), with fitted power laws and statistical details. The cluster is supported by the End Matter figure and text, and the reviewer figure evidence confirms the applicability interval [100,1000] for both branches. The extraction is complete and case_authoring_ready is true.

review_material.paper_scope: The paper studies spontaneous quantum turbulence (SQT) in a 2D Bose-Einstein condensate formed by a thermal quench, using stochastic projected Gross-Pitaevskii simulations. It establishes Kibble-Zurek scaling of vortex number and equilibration time, Kolmogorov scaling of the incompressible kinetic energy spectrum, and universal collapse of spectra under KZ rescaling. The End Matter provides fits for the total incompressible kinetic energy E_i versus quench duration tau_Q at two temperatures.
